title: BoostNet: mixing data and splits
abstract: BoostNet reports 4.2 points over SyncRet. The comparison also replaced ExtraMix-2M with BoostSplit.

paragraphs: The 4.2 point gain is not an isolated architecture effect.
SyncRet used ExtraMix-2M; BoostNet used BoostSplit.

qas.question: What extra data change accompanied BoostNet's 4.2 point gain over SyncRet?
